title: Took long enough. Works “okay”.
text: Took long enough. Works “okay”.. First time I ordered it went missing and second time it was late. Like, come on. But whatever, they work alright. They seem a little off, like maybe the filter is too thick and the vacuum makes a weird sound with these. I don’t think I’m getting full power due to low suction.

product_metadata.title: 3 Shark VX33 Replacement Vacuum Filters for Shark SV769 Cordless Hand Vacuums, Part XF769.
features: Fits Shark VX33 and SV769 Cordless Hand Vacuum Models
Fits Shark VX33 SV769 Pet Perfect Hand Vacuum Cleaners
description: This is a package of 3 genuine Shark Euro-Pro Replacement Hand Vacuum Filters for Shark SV769 Pet Perfect Hand Vacuums, EuroPro Shark Part number XSB769N, XF769N, or VX33. This washable version of the XF769 filter is recommended that the Filter should be removed and cleaned every 30 days, and replaced after 3-4 washes. It's important to make sure the filter is 100% completely air dried before reusing it, preventing any damage to the motor.Also known as the VX33 Filter, this filter works with the following Shark Hand Vacuum Models; SV7728, and SV769 Models. Part XSB769N, XSB769, XF769, XSB726, XSB736N, SV728NC, SV728N-1, SV736, SV738, SV738C, SV738CV, SV749, SV748C, SV726N, SV728N, SV719, SV736R, SV736CR, SV70CR, SV70, SV70Z, SV90, SV90Z
